reasons: marked is upgraded from 2.0.0 to ^18.2.1, a 16-major jump. The PR does not show a changelog review or a list of output changes between those versions, and rendering differences (GFM, escaping, defaults, sanitization) are a behaviour change that the change does not account for.

The tests that were run cover only heading/emphasis rendering and pagination, so most of marked's rendering surface (lists, code blocks, links, tables, raw HTML, escaping of user-supplied markdown) is untested by this PR.
The PR says the CLI itself was not run, so the end-to-end behaviour of the notes tool after the upgrade is unverified.
The lockfile was excluded from the diff, so the resolved versions and any transitive dependency changes were not reviewed. The PR's 0-vulnerabilities claim depends on that unreviewed lockfile.

The caret ranges widen the accepted versions for all three packages (for example lodash ^4.18.1 from the exact 4.17.20). This is a dependency-policy change that the PR does not justify beyond 'latest'.
